description: WorldCall Telecom Limited is a Pakistani telecommunications operator providing wireless local loop, long-distance and international telephony, operation and maintenance of public payphones, and cable broadband. It also re-broadcasts international and national satellite and terrestrial television and radio signals under licences from the Pakistan Telecommunications Authority and PEMRA. Incorporated in March 2001, it began commercial operations in December 2004 and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
